data_processing: Processing of WGBS data from 22 human diffuse glioma samples was erformed using the One Touch Pipeline (OTP) which uses bwa v0.6.1 for alignment and methylCtools v1.0.0 for methylation calling. Plus- and minus-strand methylated allele frequencies at CpG sites were merged using custom scripts. For nanopore sequencing data, raw sequencing data were basecalled using ONT's proprietary software (guppy or dorado) and aligned to hg19 using minimap2.
